about_the_game:
Welcome to Rat Race Combat: Zombie Tribute 🧟
Instead of climbing the corporate ladder, you're mowing down hordes of zombies to stay alive. Forget the office, forget meetings, forget promotions. Here, your only KPI is kills per second.

In Zombie Tribute, the rat wheel never stops. You'll run, shoot, earn credits, and spend them faster than a CEO burns through a budget. Buy better weapons, reload like your bonus depends on it, unlock shady backdoor hallways, and upgrade your arsenal into something that screams “I quit capitalism, now I just crush skulls.”

Every match resets, just like real life, only here, the repetition is fun. Enemies drop surprise power-ups, so keep hustling for that sweet dopamine hit. And if you think you're just surviving, think again. you’re also climbing the style ladder. Swap skins like you swap job titles.

Explore hidden secrets, discover bonuses, and remember: in this Rat Race, the grind is real but at least it’s full of explosions.

Punch in. Suit up. Shoot stuff. Repeat.
And this time, maybe win the Rat Race.

Key Features:

  • Earn and spend credits to survive longer

  • Upgrade weapons and unlock secret areas

  • Power-ups and random drops to spice up each run

  • Character skin customization + future in-game shop

  • Secret bonuses hidden across the map

  • Every game resets for infinite replayability

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized cartoon violence. Players use firearms to defeat humanoid rat enemies dressed in various outfits. Combat includes blood effects and the possibility of headshots, which may result in exaggerated dismemberment (e.g., exploding heads). There are no sexual themes, drug use, or self-harm depicted. The game also features optional in-game purchases.
